Selection schemes

Source: R/simulate.R
selection.Rd

Each returns a function mapping fitness values to parental sampling weights. Individuals whose development failed (`NA` fitness) get weight 0.

Usage

selection_relative_min(eps = 0.001)

selection_proportional()

selection_exponential(s = 1)

Arguments

eps

Weight given to the least fit individual.

s

Selection strength.

Functions

  • selection_relative_min(): Weights \(w - \min(w) + \epsilon\). Used by the original analysis scripts. Selection is relative to the least fit individual, so it is very strong when the population has little fitness variance.

  • selection_proportional(): Weights proportional to fitness (Wright-Fisher). Fitness must be non-negative.

  • selection_exponential(): Weights \(\exp(s w)\).
